title: Keep Player Records Alive
description: Player progress is stored in a persistent entry. Activity is bursty, so the entry can expire between sessions and take a player's progress with it. The contract must renew the entry's time-to-live on access.

content.prompt:
Which method on `env.storage().persistent()` extends a persistent entry's TTL, given a key, a threshold below which it renews, and a target TTL?

env.storage().persistent().???(&DataKey::PlayerProgress(player), THRESHOLD, EXTEND_TO);

hint: Persistent entries have their own TTL, independent of the contract instance. The renewal method takes the key plus two ledger counts: it does nothing while the remaining TTL is above the threshold and extends to the target once it falls below. Instance storage uses a two-argument variant without a key. There is no `bump` method in Soroban storage.
author: StellarHunts Core
